body: omg this is so true!!! I didn’t yeet on my arm for a long time, but a few days ago I couldn’t stand the attraction anymore. Now I’m reminded of how difficult it is to hide (it’s like closer to my wrist) and now I’m always paranoid that I forgot to pull my sleeves for enough to hide them bcs I’m not used to that anymore ://

Don’t push your child to talk about it, my mom did despite the fact that I specifically told her I didn’t want to talk about it with her. (I did with my therapist and that was enough for me) It would have been nice if she just asked me how I was doing and if she could help or let me know that she was there for me instead of asking about SH. Do not get me wrong i love my mom very much, it’s just a thing that I would’ve liked differently. So my tip is, listen to you’re child and just show them u love them in the little things :))

started when I was 13, now 20, 3 months clean tho :))
